LanguageData.CC_SetSec_Hurts_Note: Rimfolk's own small hurts: a real blow at drill, a slip on a long day, a strain worked until it gives. Never more than one in three days for anyone, none for babies, only the mildest for children, and nothing that kills outright.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_EverydayHurts_Tip:
How often Rimfolk's own small hurts come, from 0% (never) to 200% (twice as often). They also lean with the storyteller's threat and disease settings, so a peaceful game stays gentle. Each comes from something on the map, is one of the game's own wounds or one of Rimfolk's ailments, and is tended by the game's doctors. Each system's own setting still switches its part off.
They share one budget: together they come about as often as the first kinds built did, however many kinds there are now. A kind that came lately waits its turn, so the mix varies, and the others come a little more often while it rests. Switching a system off takes its kinds out of the budget, leaving the rest as they were.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_EverydayHurts: At 100%, about half a hurt a colonist-year from Rimfolk in an average colony, shared among all its kinds in turn.
LanguageData.CC_Harm_Decree_Drills: Pairs spar in the open each evening, and now and then a blow lands for real.
LanguageData.CC_Harm_Decree_Muster: A pair spars at most evenings' muster, and now and then a blow lands for real.
LanguageData.CC_Harm_Decree_ColdNights: In a hard frost, the old, the very young and the convalescent may catch a chill in a cold bedroom.
LanguageData.CC_Harm_Decree_TiredHands: Long, driven days bring a slip at the work now and then, more for those short of sleep.
